chat.label: Cloud Chat (Mattermost)

build._doc: Mattermost Mobile (React Native). 'command' is a shell snippet run from the fork root; build-fork runs it via the nix devShell for correct node/ruby/cocoapods. apk_glob captures the output. resign_unsigned=true means build-fork runs apksigner after aligning (RN builds can't embed constellation keystore easily). 'sync-on-open — prevents 20+ react-native arm64+x86_64.'

chat.comment: Mattermost Mobile. RN build; harder than mail — needs node 20 + ruby for Podfile lock.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release 'latest' (shared across the ea_cloud-* apps; each contributes a distinctly-named APK asset), overwritten every main push so https://github.com/diegonmarcos/unix/releases/latest/download/cloud-comms-chat.apk stays stable. Published by `build.sh gh-release-fork chat` (ship-cloud-chat.yml), which uploads dist/cloud-comms-chat.apk with --clobber. Consumed by ea_cloud-superapp ui.external_apps[cloud-chat].install_apk_url. The immutable timestamped per-build release (RSS notification) is separate and stays --latest=false.
